Basketball

Playground

Flick to shoot. Read the defender, then make the play.

Moves
Flick up
Shoot. Flick harder for more distance.
Long swipe
Drive left or right.
Short swipe
Jab. Jumpy defenders shift their weight; go the other way.
Snap back
Swipe the other way mid-drive to cross him over.
Swipe down
Step back. Flick as you land for a step-back jumper; slow-footed defenders get left behind.
Diagonal down
Side-step. Hop sideways, away from the way he's leaning, then shoot.
Flick mid-drive
Pull-up. Stop on a dime and rise from where you are.
Dip, then flick
Fadeaway. Pull the ball down a little before you flick up. You drift back, his contest counts for less, and the shot is a touch harder.
Tap
Pump fake.
Euro step
After a blow-by, swipe sideways on the way to the rim.
Spin
Curl your layup flick. A little spin sits soft on the rim; too much spins it out.
Chain it
Moves you make while another is finishing go next.
Help defense
Beat your man and you're attacking the rim. Flick early for a pull-up, midway for a floater, at the rim for a layup. The help defender decides which one is open.

Playmaker

Same court, same feel, but now you're running the offense. Read the defense: make the pass, or take the shot when they give it to you. Points and assists both count.

Draw It Up

A whiteboard. Draw a cut, draw the pass, then watch it run.

Featured

Passing
Flick
Pass to a spot, not a player. A longer flick throws it farther; your first two passes set how far.
Quick flick
Bullet. Flat and fast, beats a rotation.
Double tap
Lob to that spot. Tap near a teammate and it leads him. Floats over hands but hangs; at the rim, it's an alley-oop.
Flick up from your man
Shoot. Your free-throw touch from the scoring game sets how hard. Off the dribble, a flick straight at the rim is a pull-up.
Tap your man
Shot fake. Biters go up; a big parked at the rim has to come out to you.
Pull back, flick
Bounce pass. Under the hands of a man in the lane.
Curl it
Bends the pass around a defender.
Drag
Drive. Steer like a joystick from where you touched. Snap the other way to cross him.
Drag, then flick
Pass on the move: drive and kick in one motion.
Hold still
Court vision. The floor slows down and shows you the gaps, for a second or so each possession.
Tap
Pass fake. Lane jumpers jump.
Wide open
Find a man nobody can get to and it's a rhythm catch, however the pass got there.
On the money
Hit him in the shooting pocket, leading him if he's moving, and he gets a rhythm shot. Behind him or at his feet, it's late.

Lockdown

First person, guarding the ball. Every scorer gives you something: a lazy crossover, a fake with his heels down, a big who crashes. Read him and do the right thing at the right time.

Drills

Featured

Defense
Drag
Slide your feet. Small, controlled slides keep you square; lunge at his jab and your weight goes with it.
Drag up / down
Crowd him, or give him a step.
Slice through the ball
Steal. Out in front on a crossover, it's yours. Protected, it's a reach and a foul.
Flick up
Contest or block. Go up with him; on the way up it's a block, on the way down it's goaltending. Jump on his pump fake and he goes right by.
Hold still
In his path, outside the circle, set before he gets there: charge. Inside the circle: wall up.
Shot goes up
Touch and hold to box out. Slide the way he leans, then drag to the ball and flick up to jump.

HORSE

Make your shot and they have to match it from the same spot. Miss a match and you take a letter.
